question: The ultimate goal of Mission Indradhanush is to ensure full immunization with all available vaccines for children up to ________ years of age.
solution:
The correct answer is__** two.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Indradhanush is a health initiative launched by the Indian government in 2014 with the aim to immunize all children up to the age of two years.**
 
• The program focuses on providing vaccines for** vaccine-preventable diseases such as polio, measles, and hepatitis B, among others**.
 
• It aims to reach out to children in remote and underserved areas and increase the coverage of immunization in the country.
 
• The program has been successful in increasing the immunization coverage in the country from **62% in 2014 to 94% in 2019.**
 
• Immunization is a vital public health intervention that **saves millions of lives every year. It is one of the most cost-effective ways to prevent infectious diseases.**
 
• The World Health Organization recommends that all children receive** routine immunizations to protect them from vaccine-preventable diseases.**
 
• In India, despite the availability of vaccines, **many children still miss out on immunization due to various reasons such as lack of awareness, accessibility, and affordability.**
 
• Mission Indradhanush aims to address these gaps and ensure that every child in the country is protected from vaccine-preventable diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To further intensify the immunization programme, launched the Intensified Mission Indradhanush (IMI) on October 8, 2017. 
 
• The aim of Mission Indradhanush and Intensified Mission Indradhanush is to boost the routine immunization coverage 
 
• Again, the Government of India has introduced Intensified Mission Indradhanush 2.0 to ensure reaching the unreached with all available vaccines and accelerate the coverage of children and pregnant women in the identified districts and blocks from 2019-2020.
